name: The Lanterns of Acre
image_style: Illuminated-manuscript-inspired gouache and egg-tempera illustration on subtly fibrous parchment, reimagined through a surprising nocturnal palette of smoked aubergine, oxidized turquoise, tarnished saffron, and restrained vermilion. Use crisp medieval contour drawing, tiny hand-painted architectural details, stippled mineral pigments, delicate gold-leaf glints, and long flattened shadows rather than photorealism. The mood is hushed, courtly, strange, and gently comic: reverence for history and sacred architecture, with Space Ghost treated as a solemnly misplaced visitor. Keep the upper quarter spacious and low-contrast for desktop panels, with a calm widget-friendly region, while concentrating detail along the lower and middle bands. No lettering, symbols used as text, logos, watermarks, borders, or frames.
scene: A single 16:10 landscape wallpaper at twilight, showing a quiet medieval Crusader-era harbor outside Acre: accurately rendered limestone walls, a fortified gate, distant ships, and a small reverently depicted chapel with a simple cross, all bathed in muted turquoise dusk and isolated saffron lantern light. Along the lower-right quay, a few historically dressed sailors and townspeople respectfully unload sealed amphorae while Space Ghost stands beside them in his recognizable muscular white costume, black hood and mask, yellow cape, and red power bands, rigidly saluting a tiny harbor watch bell as though it were a military emergency. His cape catches an improbable breeze; the people regard him with restrained bewilderment, never worshipping or mocking the Christian setting. Leave the upper sky broad, quiet, and nearly empty, with a calm dark-water area on the left for desktop widgets. No lettering.
